scope: Offline experiment pre-lock, synthetic metadata. Final evidence uses only metadata tests. One earlier run also executed four synthetic PNG tests.

runs.name: matrix-policy-dataset-regression
args: --test-name-pattern=^(?!(?:normalized image fingerprints detect|file verification fails on source|file verifier admits human-reviewed|default file validation never opens)).*

runs.name: offline-metadata-regression
args: --test-name-pattern=^(?:offline API exists separately|shared translation request is counted once|conflicting shared request receipts|all withheld yields delivery|zero pages yields null|font loading and partial interior records|shared page request proof|partial cost observations|Canvas rerender does not)

acceptedFinal.finalSelection: Full focused file. Exact positive test names for related regressions. For these commands the sharp entry point throws before image processing.

scopeException.reason: Negative name filter did not exclude four Stage05 tests. They encoded/processed synthetic PNG in memory or OS temporary directories.
observedTests: normalized image fingerprints detect reencoding, rotation, mirror, resize and center crop candidates
file verification fails on source or annotation tampering and missing pinned submissions
file verifier admits human-reviewed submissions only after loading their pinned evidence
default file validation never opens holdout annotation labels

independentReview.method: Expected control record assembled separately from synthetic input; independent sorted-key JSON SHA-256 with node:crypto. Compared complete control record and both requested blocked decisions in memory.
